profile.headline: Software Engineer at Datadog
profile.summary:
Software engineer trying to learn more :)
Passionate about education and learning

https://github.com/michlee1337

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building ways to share your data :)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Driving product roadmap for Service Mesh component (Istio) and collaborating across stakeholders to ensure our product has reliable, safe, and observable traffic routing.
- Designed and implemented service mesh lifecycle management which gave infra operators a single pane of glass to manage upgrades and fallbacks with zero-downtime, rapid rollback, and failure isolation.
- Designed global organization API, policy and integration interfaces to extend GDCH deployments from single-zone to multi-zone to enable zonal failover and disaster recovery.
- Authored onboarding artifacts and leading onboarding of team members (6) onto the Service Mesh component.
- Volunteer teacher with WomenTeachingWomenToCode Google :)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented SDK for creating and marshalling events between different structures and formats [C++]
- Worked with another team to integrate SDK into an event delivery system via Envoy

positions.title: Full-stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Set up simple tracking of key metrics (Google Analytics, MySQL, Python).
- Increased user registration 4x by reducing the registration process to one step using token verification (Ruby on Rails, MySQL). 
- Increased user engagement 6x by proposing, designing, and implementing various UX changes including map integration and goshuincho album feature (Google Maps API).

positions.title: CodeU Participant
positions.description:
- Designed and created a group-study organisation app with real time progress visualisations and a study-buddy recommendation system (Java, Google App Engine).
- Trained in industry best practices under Google mentors.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description: - Made their website responsive (mobile and tablet view)

positions.title: Project Co-Leader and Programmer
positions.description:
- Co-lead a team of 10 to ease the key limitation of teaching staff by building an offline, lightweight command line grading program ​(JavaScript)​.
- Built a web app that updates a progress visualisation in response to successful code submissions ​(Git Hooks).

positions.title: Project Co-Leader and Programmer
positions.description: - Automated vendor name and location extraction from bank memos on a previously uncategorizable dataset by combining a rule-based and CRF (adapted from Stanford NLP) model (75% accuracy).

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: - Held weekly lessons for classes of ~15 on programming fundamentals in Python.

positions.title: Board Member and Alumni Mentor
positions.description:
- Created, documented, and organised core protocols and references.
- Mentored current student directors.

positions.title: KL Executive Director
positions.description:
A global youth led movement against human trafficking. 
• Lea a team of 30 youth whilst coordinating with counterparts in Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore.
• Raised over RM250,000 for SUKA Society through fundraising events, merchandise sales, and donations.
• Planned two core events: a 1000 PAX 24-hour race and music festival, and a 100 PAX fundraising dinner gala with notable speakers, an art auction, and performances.
• Interviewed with Thomas Reuters Foundation, Astro Awani, Traxx FM, and other media agencies.

positions.title: Digital Support, Project Assistant, and Research & Publications Support
positions.description:
A non-profit organisation that addresses Asia’s problems in areas of public entrepreneurship, leadership, and education
• Assisted in the planning and coordination of experiential educational treks, discussion forums, conferences, and other leadership events.
• Maintained the website and prepared standard documents (e.g.: MOUs, booklets, certificates).
• Assisted in the editing of Acumen Case Center Publications.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: - Assisted lab preparations in the Monash Neurobusiness Behavioural Laboratory under Professor Motoki, Research Professor.

honors.title: First Net Public Safety Hackathon: Best Tech Use Case and Second Runner-Up Overall
honors.description:
Built a Web App for First Responder Commanders to monitor and coordinate operations
https://github.com/FirstNetHack

honors.title: Women in Blockchain Hackathon: Grand Prize
honors.description:
Built a DApp for research funding, publishing, and peer reviewing on Ethereum.
https://github.com/weiting109/lovelace
honors.issuer: Issued by Team Block Society · Mar 2018

volunteerExperiences.description: - Raised over 260,000 USD for SUKA Society, a Malaysian NGO fighting child trafficking and recipient of the UN Malaysia Award 2015.
- Helped maintain and operate a small boarding school for vulnerable populations  in Bentong founded by an elderly couple and funded with their pension funds.

projects.title: Context-graph based resource searching
projects.description:
Personal project to support adult learners to better find free online learning resources they need for their context by letting them filter searches based on education metadata and refine searches based on common new learner search errors.

Old writeup on mental models and self-directed learning: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ox7XjB1VtSx2qFoDq0pieUCMz7AE9EDSkGPPpYJtELY/edit
